value.rationale: Original source supplies local bifurcation and numerical chaos, not global symbolic repeller geometry. This result gives a genuine two-parameter open region of nonzero coupling, explicit sixteen-symbol sixth-return coding, and a nontrivial asymptotically sharp family of entropy witnesses converging to the intrinsic boundary entropy \(\log2\). It is not just a restatement of a logistic product at forbidden a=0 or of complex periodic-point counts; the persistence and entire branch-family construction are essential. The limiting decoupled full logistic product has exact compact dynamical entropy \(\log2\), furnishing an intrinsic sharp benchmark.
